rationale: Kaede and Nachiappan both work in hardware and embedded systems, but from complementary angles—Kaede brings professional field application engineering experience at Seeed Studio helping developers build IoT solutions, while Nachiappan is an active student builder with hands-on PCB design and embedded systems projects. Nachiappan's growing technical stack (Python, C++, TypeScript) and focus on custom hardware and computer vision aligns well with the kinds of developer challenges Kaede helps solve in the field, making this a natural mentor-builder pairing.
intro_message: Kaede Lin, meet Nachiappan Thenappan — Kaede helps developers build IoT and embedded solutions at Seeed Studio, and Nachiappan is a hands-on student builder exploring PCB design and embedded systems, so you'd likely have a lot to discuss about practical hardware development.
